detours.why: Day Hall, Flint Hall and Graham Dining Hall sit on top of Mount Olympus, a steep hill whose only mapped ways up are the Mount steps and drive on its west side, so walks between the hilltop and the buildings below go round by them.

City blocks between Marshall Street and University Place: buildings fill the blocks between these halls' doors and Huntington Hall's and the Veterans Resource Center's, with no mapped way through, so walks go round by the streets.
